title: LTBD: Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters for Prompt Injection Defense
abstract: arXiv:2610.11634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform remarkably well on complex tasks, yet remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions embedded in external data can override user intent. Existing defenses remain limited by model fine-tuning requirements, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, or reliance on brittle handcrafted prompts. We argue that a fundamental source of this vulnerability is the lack of an explicit representation of trust provenance. To address this, we introduce Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters (LTBD), a lightweight defense that explicitly encodes trust boundaries in the input while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. LTBD uses a small number of learnable delimiters to distinguish trusted user instructions from untrusted external data, enabling the model to better respect the intended trust hierarchy. translated_title: LTBD：用于提示注入防御的可学习信任边界分隔符
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂任务上表现出色，但仍然极易受到提示注入攻击——嵌入在外部数据中的恶意指令可以覆盖用户意图。现有防御方法存在局限性：需要模型微调、易受自适应攻击，或依赖脆弱的手工设计提示。我们认为，这种脆弱性的一个根本原因在于缺乏对信任来源的显式表示。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可学习信任边界分隔符（LTBD），这是一种轻量级防御方法，它在输入中显式编码信任边界，同时保持LLM参数不变。LTBD使用少量可学习的分隔符来区分受信任的用户指令与不受信任的外部数据，使模型能够更好地遵循预期的信任层级。实验结果表明，LTBD大幅优于推理时防御方法……
tldr: 提出了一种轻量级防御方法LTBD，通过少量可学习的分隔符在输入中显式编码信任边界，在不修改LLM参数的情况下有效抵御提示注入攻击。
en_tdlr: LTBD, a lightweight defense that uses a small number of learnable delimiters to explicitly encode trust boundaries in the input, effectively defending against prompt injection attacks without modifying LLM parameters.
